title: Sudoku Solver
description: Solve any valid Sudoku with a real backtracking search: type the givens, get the full solution plus the solver's step and backtrack counts.
howto: Type the given digits into the 9×9 grid (leave unknown cells blank or 0).
Press Solve — a backtracking search fills the grid.
Read the solution with your original givens highlighted, plus steps and backtracks.
Use Clear to reset or Sample to load a classic puzzle.

faqs.a: Depth-first backtracking: it picks the empty cell with the fewest candidates, tries each, and recurses. If a branch dead-ends it backtracks. The step counter shows every placement attempt.

faqs.q: What if my puzzle has no solution?
faqs.a: The tool detects contradictions (including invalid givens that break Sudoku rules) and tells you the puzzle is unsolvable instead of guessing.
It returns the first solution found. A well-posed Sudoku has exactly one; if yours has several, the tool still gives a valid completion.
